reviews.text: This is a wonderful hospital. It's now far from my home, but it saved my life... Thank you so much. I'm truly grateful. It gets crowded. The staff are human beings too, so I'm sure they have their own issues, but considering the number of animals they examine and treat, if we could just treat them with a little more generosity and gratitude, I don't think it would be an unpleasant experience at all. I sincerely hope the hospital continues to operate for a long, long time.
They will examine you very carefully.

My dog ​​is receiving excellent care here.

He has a skin problem, but you kindly and thoroughly answered all my questions about his condition and provided a memo outlining the treatment plan.

His symptoms are improving faster than I expected, and he's sleeping much better now.

Thank you so much!

2025 Update
As others have mentioned,
the new staff member with the brown bob haircut has a bad attitude.
She remains silent when I call to make appointments, and
there have been several instances where she hasn't prepared the medication I ordered.
The other day, I overheard a pet owner who had been served by this staff member complaining to their family, who were picking them up in the car, on the phone, "The receptionist here is really rude."
It's a real shame, especially since the doctors and other staff members are generally very nice, and I hope they will make improvements.

I've been a patient here for a long time, and they are always kind and polite.
The male doctor seems less talkative than the female doctor.
Incidentally, the female doctor is available both in the morning and afternoon, but the male head doctor only sees patients in the afternoon.

It's always crowded, and since appointments became the norm due to the pandemic, it's difficult to get an appointment even a week in advance.
For morning appointments, the earliest available is sometimes 10 days away.

If you're making an appointment for an ultrasound or surgery, it will be 2-3 weeks in advance.

Even with an appointment, it's common to be delayed beyond your scheduled time.

If you go without an appointment, you'll be seen after the last appointment of the morning or afternoon. For example, if you go at 10am, you won't be seen until after 12pm.

I've even gone at 6:30pm and wasn't seen until after 8pm, with payment around 9pm.

It's stressful for the animal to be kept waiting for hours, especially if you went without an appointment because your pet was unwell and couldn't wait days for a new one.

It might be a good hospital for preventative care like vaccinations, checkups, and regular check-ups for chronic conditions, but if you go without an appointment when your pet is sick, be prepared for waits comparable to a university hospital.

I don't think it's suitable for emergencies.

Also, even in the middle of summer, the air conditioning in the hospital is only on very low, so owners of long-haired or brachycephalic breeds should be aware of this.

Thank you for your continued support.

The teachers are very kind and considerate. Because of this, there may be a short wait, but it's well worth it for entrusting your precious child to them.

This is the animal hospital I always use.

The doctor is very kind, trustworthy, and a wonderful person.

However, I am writing this review because of the extremely poor attitude of the new receptionist/nurse, a woman with short brown hair and no glasses.

She seemed irritated throughout, spoke softly, and responded to questions curtly.

Her attitude made me wonder why she's still working there if she dislikes the job so much.

Honestly, her behavior didn't seem like someone who loved animals, and it was sad to watch.

Because I trust the doctor so much, having staff like this makes me uneasy.

I can no longer confidently entrust my pet to the pet hotel or for care during vet visits.

Since this is a place where I entrust my precious pet's life, I strongly hope that the staff's attitude will be improved.
Thank you for your continued support.

This is our regular vet for both our cat and dog. They also offer pet boarding services. The veterinarians are thorough and we feel confident in the treatment they provide. We trust them, which is why we continue to go there. It gets crowded, and you have to wait even with an appointment, but it's well worth it.

I went there before we moved.
My cat developed urinary stones and they were very helpful.
The doctor was a man, and he answered all of my detailed questions carefully.
My cat recovered well and is still doing very well today.
I remember the consultation fees were also very reasonable.
If you live nearby, be sure to check them out!

They are truly considerate to both our beloved cats and us!
I think the reason there are always so many patients is because they know that the director and his wife, as well as the staff and doctors, really care for their pets.
I will continue to go to Step Animal Hospital from now on! (^^)

Not only is the teacher kind, but he also takes great care of the rescued cats.
I think he is a sincere teacher.
